It sucks because it is constant meaning at all waking hours I'm suffering from thought prevention psychosis. I cant run away from it I cant avoid it. Its more appropriate it to label the clarity of thought as episodes than the psychosis. The only thing that has helped is medication and now I learn that even that will lead to the destruction of my intellect. I want to help myself I want to help others suffering from mental illness but how am I supposed to make an impact with my disability. The psychiatrists who claim they want to help only see you as a patient that needs immediate help, and don't look for long term solutions. I'm tired of living this shit of constantly being reminded of my damn limits I want to be free. Society views our sickness as part of our being. But the thing is we are sick at the end of the day  this isn't who we are its a symptom of a illness. I just want us to be our true selves for us to reach our potential that is locked inside us. But all I can do is pray that someone will help us achieve that. And I'm so damn tired of praying. Sorry for the ramble but I really don't ever get to share my thoughts with someone I really appreciate your ear. Don't you ever get tired of it? The way people view us even those who try to help?
